device: AT24C256 family: 32768 bytes, two word-address bytes; byte operations only

device_address.doc: 7-bit strapped address. Family superset 0x50..0x57 includes newer C variants; legacy AT24C256 uses 0x50..0x53. Confirm the exact device/module; default 0x50 works at all-low address straps.

word_address.doc: Byte address used by generated programs, 0..32767. This default is a planning address, not permission to overwrite an unreserved EEPROM location.

data_byte.doc: Byte-write payload, 0..255; runtime software, never FPGA identity.

write_timeout_ms.doc: Positive host readiness deadline including program reload, USB/SPI transport and probe execution. This is not a device tWR specification or measurement.

poll_interval_ms.doc: Positive host pause between completed readiness probes; must not exceed readiness deadline.

program_timeout_ms.doc: Positive host deadline for one runtime program to reach HALT.

read_iterations.doc: Positive acceptance repetition count; the first read is the backup value.

write_iterations.doc: Positive byte-write/read acceptance count when the operator requests write testing; restore the original byte afterwards.
